verdict: All leads came from Meta; Google's $1,997 spend returned zero leads.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 36 leads at $104.87 per lead — every single one from Meta, while Google Ads spent $1,997 and produced zero conversions. Google is being reviewed this week and spend will be reallocated until that channel demonstrates it can convert. On the bright side, your Google Business Profile picked up meaningfully, with local actions up 33% week over week, including 28 calls and 65 direction requests. The more pressing issue to address beyond ads is your intake pipeline: 98 opportunities were opened in the CRM this period with no appointments booked and no cases won, which points to a follow-up gap rather than an ads problem. Tightening intake response is the fastest way to turn leads already in hand into clients.
